title: Triple Glass Shelf 16-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass | Venetian Bronze | Carolina | Allied Brass | Bathroom Wall Shelf Storage | Allied Brass
description:
Get organized bathroom storage without crowding the vanity—this triple glass shelf adds three levels of space in one wall-mounted unit in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. It works as a glass shelf, bathroom shelf, and wall shelf for daily essentials while keeping a classic look.

Highlights:
- Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Pairs elegantly with matching Carolina hardware for refined warmth
- Choose from 56 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Classic coordination: made to pair with matching Carolina collection pieces for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Triple glass shelf / glass shelving unit (wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging)
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Approx. overall (16-inch model): 16 in L x 5.54 in D x 16 in H
- Weight (16-inch model): 11.2 lbs
- Mounting: Wall mount with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Materials: Thick beveled-edge glass; brass construction hardware
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Multiple designer finish options available
